1.text: Bafata hakurya y'inyanja mu gihugu cy'Abagadareni.

2.text: Yomotse, uwo mwanya umuntu utewe na dayimoni ava mu mva, aramusanganira.

3.text: Yabaga mu mva, ntawari ukibona icyo ashobora kumubohesha n'aho waba umunyururu,

4.text: kuko kenshi bamubohesheje ingoyi y'amaguru n'iminyururu y'amaboko, maze ingoyi akayicagagura n'iminyururu akayivunagura, ntihagira umuntu ubasha kumuhosha.

5.text: Iteka ryose ku manywa na nijoro, yahoraga mu mva no ku misozi asakurizayo, yikebesha amabuye.

6.text: Abonye Yesu akiri kure, arirukanka aramupfukamira,

7.text: ataka ijwi rirenga ati “Duhuriye he Yesu, Mwana w'Imana Isumbabyose? Nkurahirije Imana, ntunyice urupfu n'agashinyaguro”

9.text: Aramubaza ati “Witwa nde?”Undi ati “Ingabo ni ryo zina ryanjye, kuko turi benshi.”

10.text: Aramwinginga cyane ngo atabirukana muri icyo gihugu.

11.text: Kuri uwo musozi hari umugana w'ingurube nyinshi zirisha,

12.text: nuko baramwinginga bati “Twohereze muri ziriya ngurube tuzinjiremo.”

13.text: Arabakundira. Abadayimoni bamuvamo binjira muri izo ngurube, umugana wirukira ku gacuri zīsuka mu nyanja, zihotorwa n'amazi, zari nk'ibihumbi bibiri.

14.text: Abungeri bazo barahunga, babibwira abo mu mudugudu n'abo mu ngo baza kureba uko bibaye.

15.text: Bageze aho Yesu ari basanga uwari utewe n'ingabo z'abadayimoni yicaye, yambaye afite ubwenge nk'abandi, baratinya.

16.text: Ababonye ibyabaye kuri uwo muntu n'ingurube babitekerereza abandi,

17.text: baherako baramwinginga ngo ave mu gihugu cyabo.

18.text: Acyikira mu bwato, wa muntu wari utewe n'abadayimoni aramwinginga ngo bajyane,

19.text: ariko ntiyamukundira ahubwo aramubwira ati “Witahire ujye mu banyu, ubabwire ibyo Imana igukoreye byose n'uko ikubabariye.”

20.text: Aragenda, atangira kwamamaza i Dekapoli ibyo Yesu yamukoreye byose, abantu bose barumirwa.

21.text: Nuko Yesu agenda mu bwato asubira hakurya, abantu benshi bateranira aho ari iruhande rw'inyanja.

22.text: Umwe mu batware b'isinagogi witwaga Yayiro araza, amubonye yikubita imbere y'ibirenge bye

23.text: aramwinginga cyane ati “Agakobwa kanjye karenda gupfa, ndakwinginze uze ukarambikeho ibiganza byawe, gakire kabeho.”

24.text: Aragenda ajyana na we, abantu benshi baramukurikira bamubyiga.

25.text: Nuko hariho umugore wari mu mugongo, wari ubimaranye imyaka cumi n'ibiri,

26.text: ababazwa n'abavuzi cyane benshi bagerageza kumukiza, bamumarisha ibintu bye byose abitangamo ingemu, ariko ntibagira icyo bamumarira ahubwo arushaho kurwara.

27.text: Yumvise ibya Yesu araza aca mu bantu, amuturuka inyuma akora ku mwenda we,

28.text: kuko yari yibwiye ati “Ninkora imyenda ye gusa ndakira.”

29.text: Uwo mwanya isōko y'amaraso irakama, amenya mu mubiri we yuko akize cya cyago.

30.text: Yesu na we yiyumvamo ko ubushobozi bumugabanutsemo, ahindukira abyigana n'abantu arababaza ati “Ni nde ukoze umwenda wanjye?”

31.text: Abigishwa be baramusubiza bati “Ese ye, abantu barakubyiga nawe ukagira ngo ‘Ni nde unkozeho?’ ”

32.text: Abararanganyamo amaso agira ngo abone umukozeho.

33.text: Uwo mugore aratinya, ahinda umushyitsi kuko azi ikimubayeho, araza amwikubita imbere amubwira iby'ukuri byose.

34.text: Aramubwira ati “Mwana wanjye, kwizera kwawe kuragukijije, wigendere amahoro ukire rwose icyago cyawe.”

35.text: Akivugana na we haza abavuye kuri wa mutware w'isinagogi bati “Wa mwana ko yapfuye uracyaruhiriza iki umwigisha?”

36.text: Ariko Yesu ntiyabyitaho abwira umutware w'isinagogi ati “Witinya izere gusa.”

37.text: Ntiyakundira undi muntu kujyana na we, keretse Petero na Yakobo na Yohana, mwene se wa Yakobo.

38.text: Bageze mu muryango w'inzu y'umutware w'isinagogi, ahasanga urusaku rw'abarira n'ababoroga cyane.

39.text: Nuko yinjiye arababaza ati “Ni iki gitumye musakuza kandi murira? Umwana ntiyapfuye ahubwo arasinziriye.”

40.text: Baramuseka cyane. Arabaheza bose ajyana se w'umwana na nyina n'abari kumwe na we, ajya aho uwo mwana ari.

41.text: Amufata ukuboko aramubwira ati“Talisa, kumi” bisobanurwa ngo “Gakobwa, ndakubwira nti ‘Byuka.’ ”

42.text: Uwo mwanya ako gakobwa karabyuka karagenda, kuko kari kamaze imyaka cumi n'ibiri kavutse. Uwo mwanya barumirwa cyane.

43.text: Yesu arabihanangiriza cyane ngo hatagira umuntu wese ubimenya, abategeka gufungurira ako kana.
